317:t_1:86.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「It seems the public is being told that was a natural disaster.」

317:t_1:87.en:
$$バニラ$$
「Well, of course. If people heard that a device somebody built caused a $$時空震動$$, the whole world would go into an uproar.」

317:t_1:88.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「The $$ＵＣＷ$$ researched that sort of technology too, but after the chaos that followed and the failed experiments, it has come to a complete standstill.」

317:t_1:89.en:
$$クルーゾー$$
「All the more reason the technical power of $$アマルガム$$, who actually perfected it, is beyond imagination.」

317:t_1:90.en:
$$ゴウト$$
「Put that opponent off for later. First comes the $$黒い稲妻旅団$$.」

317:t_1:91.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「Awfully grand a name for a gang of bandits.」

317:t_1:92.en:
$$バニラ$$
「They say they used to be an army unit, but they're a bunch who do whatever they please, slipping in amid the confusion while the Empire throws its weight around.」

317:t_1:93.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「Whether they deserve to call themselves Black is something we'll see with our own eyes.」

317:t_1:94.en:
$$ゴウト$$
「Their forces are mainly $$ＡＴ$$s, but they've got a considerable number of them, I'll warn you.」

317:t_1:95.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「A band of outlaws exploiting the world's confusion. There seems to be no room for negotiation.」

317:t_1:96.en:
$$バニラ$$
「Now, now, now... Save your negotiating skills for somewhere else.」

317:t_1:97.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「Very well. Then I'll put them to use negotiating our fee for this job.」

317:t_1:98.en:
$$バニラ$$
「W-wait a minute...! That's not what I meant!」

317:t_1:99.en:
$$ゴウト$$
「Well, don't worry. $$バニラ$$ and I are executives of the chamber of commerce here in $$グルフェー$$, after all.」

317:t_1:100.en:
$$ゴウト$$
「I have no intention of haggling the fee down more than necessary.」

317:t_1:101.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「'More than necessary'... Those words light a fire under my negotiator's soul.」

317:t_1:102.en:
$$ゴウト$$
「Ha ha... Go easy on me, $$ロジャー$$.」

317:t_1:103.en:
$$市民$$
「...$$ゴウト$$. Are those the bodyguards you hired?」

317:t_1:104.en:
$$ゴウト$$
「Oh, yes. They're acquaintances of mine, and they're certainly skilled.」

317:t_1:105.en:
$$市民$$
「Even without hiring people like that, salvation will be coming from the Church soon enough...」

317:t_1:106.en:
$$バニラ$$
「...What's this, are you still grumbling?」

317:t_1:107.en:
$$ゴウト$$
「Can't be helped. We'll never understand what goes on in their heads.」

317:t_1:108.en:
$$クルーゾー$$
「Who was that just now?」

317:t_1:109.en:
$$ゴウト$$
「One of the other executives of the $$グルフェー$$ chamber of commerce, same as us.」

317:t_1:110.en:
$$ゴウト$$
「And while we're at it, he's a believer in $$マーティアル$$.」

317:t_1:117.en:
$n
「I'd pictured somewhere a lot more crowded and grimy...」

317:t_1:118.en:
$$ココナ$$
「$$グルフェー$$ is the center of the information industry around here. A lot of the people in this city are what you'd call rich.」

317:t_1:119.en:
$$スズネ$$
「So that's why the bandits go after it...」

317:t_1:120.en:
$$ココナ$$
「But it's okay...! With $$キリコ$$ and you guys here, there's nothing to worry about.」

317:t_1:121.en:
$n
「I'll do my best to live up to your expectations.」

317:t_1:122.en:
$$カレン$$
「With the world in such a mess, we can't just let people who do whatever they like to satisfy their own desires run loose.」

317:t_1:124.en:
$$カレン$$
「Yeah. And of course, neither has $$キリコ$$.」

317:t_1:128.en:
$$ココナ$$
「Those clothes... They must be $$マーティアル$$ followers.」

317:t_1:129.en:
$$市民$$
「...Thus, the principle of all things is the harmony of strife. Bring battle to the love of the universe, bring battle to the father and mother of the universe. Battle, battle, battle...」

317:t_1:131.en:
$$市民$$
「Through battle we shall seek the way of God. Let my $$マーティアル$$, let my $$マーティアル$$...」

317:t_1:133.en:
$$市民$$
「As for those bandits, a Shield of Order will come from $$アレギウム$$ and wipe them out in no time.」

317:t_1:135.en:
$$市民$$
「Really. $$マーティアル$$ is strong, after all.」

317:t_1:136.en:
$$市民$$
「'Martial prowess is true harmony,' you know.」

317:t_1:139.en:
$$市民$$
「I just don't like it somehow... Being told to fight, fight, fight...」

317:t_1:140.en:
$$市民$$
「That's the teaching of $$マーティアル$$.」

317:t_1:144.en:
$$キリコ$$
「...$$ココナ$$. What about the thing I asked $$ゴウト$$ for?」

317:t_1:145.en:
$$ココナ$$
「Oh... yeah... I think it's all ready.」

317:t_1:146.en:
$$ココナ$$
「The custom parts for the assault spec of the $$スコープドッグ$$... With those, we're invincible.」

317:t_1:152.en:
$$キリコ$$
(...Battle, battle, battle... A child's voice kept repeating over and over in my head...)

317:t_1:153.en:
$$キリコ$$
(Battle... The thing that swallowed up me and $$フィアナ$$ and never let us go...)

317:t_1:154.en:
$$キリコ$$
(The god who sings its praises... I couldn't bring myself to acknowledge that such a being exists...)

318:t_000:0.en:
$$ナミ$$
「How is it, $$宗介$$? I swapped the muscle package out for a better one, like you told me to.」

318:t_000:1.en:
$$宗介$$
「Not bad. I can fight well enough with this.」

318:t_000:2.en:
$$レモン$$
「Still, I thought it was strange you had me buy paint, and then you custom-paint an AS...」

318:t_000:3.en:
$$宗介$$
「I hear it's a standard bit of showmanship in arenas and battling.」

318:t_000:4.en:
$$ナミ$$
「《$$バトリング$$》...? Did you pilot $$ＡＴ$$s too?」

318:t_000:5.en:
$$宗介$$
「It's something an acquaintance told me.」

318:t_000:6.en:
$$ナミ$$
「But be careful. $$ＡＴ$$ pilots enter the arena here too, and the level is pretty high.」

318:t_000:7.en:
$$ナミ$$
「On top of that, real battles with firearms are the norm.」

318:t_000:8.en:
$$宗介$$
「No problem. I'm more used to that.」

318:t_000:10.en:
$$宗介$$
「Besides, there's also $$メララ$$'s shot cannon. It's reassuring to have equipment I'm used to.」

318:t_000:11.en:
$$ナミ$$
「You're Japanese, aren't you? I heard Japan is still more or less peaceful even with the world in this state...」

318:t_000:14.en:
$$宗介$$
「I see... I thought it was an unusual name for a resident here...」

318:t_000:15.en:
$$宗介$$
(Maybe that's why... When I first saw $$ナミ$$, she reminded me of $$千鳥$$...)

318:t_000:16.en:
$$ナミ$$
「So... what's with that color scheme?」
